**Finding: deviation (medium) — WARRANTY**

Kubient's warranty package in Section 9(b) is reasonably broad on substance (non-infringement, industry-standard performance, security, no malicious code, compliance with Laws, services "free from errors that materially affect their utility"), but it is missing three playbook elements:

1. No professional and workmanlike services warranty;
2. No warranty period for conformance of the Service/deliverables to documentation; and
3. No remedy — nothing entitles us to re-performance, repair/replacement or a refund.

The Section 13 disclaimer is acceptable as drafted: it opens "Except as expressly set forth herein" and expressly preserves "the representations and warranties set forth in this Agreement," so the "as is" language does not swallow the express warranties. No carve-out edit was needed there.

**Redline (validated, ok:true):** inserted new clauses (xii)–(xiii) after p0041 adding the workmanlike warranty, a 90-day services / 12-month software-deliverable conformance period, and a re-performance, repair/replacement or refund remedy that is non-exclusive of our other rights. The comment offers the 90-day fallback for software deliverables.
